name: native-dual
displayName: iOS + Android native (Swift · Kotlin, one each)
description: Two per-platform codebases — Swift + SwiftUI for iOS, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose for Android. Uses ios-swift and android-kotlin together.

notes.platformBoundary: Tokens go in the platform secure storage (Keychain · Android Keystore)
notes.toolchain: **There are two toolchains.** The representative command is confirmed as a root script (a Makefile, etc.) that runs both platforms — without one, build-gate verifies only one side
notes.sourceDirs: Android code lives in android/ — the preset sourceDir is a single value, so it holds only ios. init Step 4.7 takes both directories and puts them into the card paths together
notes.parity: The same feature is implemented twice. The canonical screen and domain rules live in a shared contract (API · design tokens), and both implementations follow it
